name: TandoorRecipes
description: Tandoor Recipes is a Django application to manage, tag and search recipes using either built in models or external storage providers hosting PDF's, Images or other files.

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: Timezone in TZ format. See here: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_tz_database_time_zones

variables.name: Database Engine
variables.description: Either SQLite (default for unRAID) or PostgreSQL with: django.db.backends.postgresql

variables.name: Secret Key
variables.description: Randomly generate a secret key please.

variables.name: Allowed Hosts
variables.description: Either * for all, or specific domains/subdomains, etc.

variables.name: Comment System
variables.description: Enables or disables the comment system.

variables.name: Serve Gunicorn Meida
variables.description: Enables serving media files directly from Gunicorn.

variables.name: PostgreSQL Host
variables.description: Host for PostgreSQL, should you choose to use it.

variables.name: PostgreSQL Port
variables.description: Port for PostgreSQL server shouldy you choose to use it.

variables.name: PostgreSQL User
variables.description: User for PostgreSQL should you choose to use it.

variables.name: PostgreSQL Password
variables.description: Password for PostgreSQL should you choose to use it.

variables.name: Database
variables.description: Name of SQLite database, or the name of your PostgreSQL database if you are using that.
